subject: sir-trashmuffin
q: Where did the second donut go?
detail:
6 September, Ghost Haven kitchen. He took ONE donut, washed it into ruin, took a SECOND, and carried it away through the Raceway toward the basement without eating it. He has unlimited access and a demonstrated appetite for whole boxes, so this was not restraint and not incapacity. HE HAS A SECOND DEN ON THE TEA SIDE AND VISITS ON BAD DAYS SPECIFICALLY — which makes a delivery a SUPPORTED READ rather than a guess, and it is still not being asserted. Whether it was a bad day down there is unconfirmed.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. Same place as all the others: in his belly. RETIRED.
